Sea air and dust are hard on a chain. A few minutes a week keeps it quiet and makes it last.

## Every week
- Backpedal the chain through a dry cloth until the cloth comes away clean.
- Put one drop of lube on each roller, on the inside of the chain.
- Backpedal a few turns, then wipe off the excess - extra lube picks up more dust.

## When to bring it in
If the chain squeaks or grinds after a clean, or the gears skip, the drivetrain needs a proper look. Request a service on the Workshop page and we'll confirm a day and time.
Sea air and dust wear a chain fast. A weekly wipe and a drop of lube go a long way.
